fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: Dashboard chat alias (Validate). Required for engine=grid. Ignored for engine=http — use model_alpha instead.

fields.name: model_alpha
fields.label: Systemone model
fields.description: Model id sent to POST /v1/systemone when engine=http. Required for http runs; the dashboard chat model is not used.

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Server origin. Trailing /v1 or /v1/systemone is stripped. For engine=http this is the systemone origin; for engine=grid /v1 is appended for chat completions.

fields.name: engine
fields.label: Engine
fields.description: http: POST /v1/systemone (default). grid: chat completions. random: uniform baseline, no model call.

fields.name: task_range
fields.label: Task range
fields.description: Inclusive row indices, e.g. 0-9 runs rows 0 through 9, 50-100 runs rows 50 through 100. Leave empty for the full suite.

fields.name: delay_s
fields.label: Delay between requests (seconds)
fields.description: Sleep between API calls to stay under rate limits (default 0.5s ≈ 120 RPM).

fields.name: resume
fields.label: Resume
fields.description: Keep a partial results.jsonl in this run directory. false starts over.

fields.name: suite_dataset
fields.label: Suite dataset
fields.description: Private Hugging Face dataset you uploaded with prepare_hub_upload.py (selected-rows, added-rows, exclusions, manifest). Required for dashboard runs unless the VM already has a verified suite-0.2/ directory.
